notes: Research article with original Sieverts data on carbide-derived carbons (TiC, SiC, Mo2C precursors), activated carbons incl. AX21 for comparison; excess isotherms to 60 bar at 77 K. Section 2.1: 'CDC powders were produced by chlorination of TiC, SiC and Mo2C powders.' BET SSA for the same batches used for H2 uptake (p. 3, Section 2.2 text: 'the values included in Table 1 were measured on the same batches of CDC that were used for hydrogen storage in this work'). Not a review: authors extend their previous 1 bar study to 60 bar; the paper does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. record.json is_retracted is false and the PDF text shows no retraction notice.
